name: Minamoto Sayuri
source:
Beautiful and enigmatic, Sayuri is an expert player at the social and political games of the court. She comes from an extremely wealthy family, and it shows. An enthusiast of the finer things in life, she is always up to date with both fashion and gossip, and never misses a chance to display her talent for poetry.

As a child Sayuri was traded as a “hostage” with the child of an infamous ninja clan to ensure that no hostilities would break out between the families. She spent several years there growing up, and though she was eventually returned to her own family, no one is quite sure where her loyalties lie.

[From [url=http://hub.leadingscientistsgames.com/about/characters/minamoto-sayuri/]official site[/url]]
